name: Konstantinos Karydis
title: Professor
department: Electrical and Computer Engineering; Center for Robotics and Intelligent Systems
fitReason: Strong intersection of machine learning, robot perception, field deployment and nonlinear control. Current work includes learned multimodal vineyard perception on a moving robot, with prior perception-to-manipulation integration; the latest learned multi-robot control study itself remains simulation-only.

physicalEvidence.summary: March 20, 2026 paper deploys SAM-assisted pseudo-labeling and a YOLOv10n-based cross-modal detector with AG-LOAM/tree association on a Clearpath Jackal carrying ZED2i, Mapir NIR, FLIR thermal and Velodyne VLP-16 sensors. Section V reports on-the-go detection/localization in two actual Gallo vineyards at 0.5 m/s; it establishes learned field perception, not a learned motion controller. June 2026 UCR reporting identifies first author Dimitrios Chatziparaschis as a current UCR graduate researcher. Separate avocado work, first published May 2025, integrates YOLOv8n-seg and motion planning on a dual-arm UAV platform. The accessible 2024 author manuscript distinguishes static-UAV tests with real fruit from teleoperated flight with artificial fruit; it does not demonstrate fully autonomous flight harvesting in a natural orchard.

shortVisit.summary: Current ARCS joining page recruits PhD/postdoc and local undergraduate work. Its rolling MS openings require acceptance into UCR ROBO/EE/CE/CS/ME programs; it directs non-UCR degree applicants to central admissions. No current external-master's visitor or eight-week route is explicitly offered.

scoreReasons.fit: Strong robot ML/perception/control overlap; newest learned multi-robot controller has only simulation validation.
scoreReasons.physical: Current named field robot and online learned perception, plus older learned-perception manipulation. Reduced from25 because strongest recent hardware evidence concerns detection/localization rather than learned physical control.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: Current MS recruitment is for UCR-admitted students; no external short-visit route verified.
scoreReasons.freshness: March and September2026 technical records, June2026 institutional research and direct current rendered faculty profile.
